summary: Paging skills from a database (page table plus pinned Workflow plus one matched section): 46% less text, 21% fewer tool calls; eviction impossible.

Result on 57 prompts, thresholds tuned on the other half: 17,961 to 9,769 chars per request, 2.18 to 1.72 tool calls, 44% of each skill loaded. Paging out is impossible because context is append-only. Upload file count unchanged at 66. Page-fault rate unmeasured; needs blind task grading. Self-memory already uses this progressive pattern. Carried forward from a 1.0.0 branch snapshot, where it was EXP-0006.

A word-count guard that dropped guesses on sentences scored +2 and -1 on the two held-out halves: noise, so no behaviour change. Whether dropping guesses helps depends on how well the routers do on the same prompts, which needs a blind grade and routing_eval.py compare.
